quotes.author: Bridgette Breault
quotes.text: I surprised my aviation obsessed son with a helicopter tour that checks off the first thing of our summer bucket list! He loved it and I couldn’t stop smiling! Chris was fun and knowledgeable of the area. I would fly every say if I could! Worth every penny. Terrific outing! Beautiful weather, scenery, clean heli, and memories that will last forever.

quotes.author: Juan Rosales
quotes.text: This was my girlfriend and I first helicopter ride and it was honestly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had. Chris is a great pilot. He made sure we felt safe and comfortable the whole ride. Gave us some good information throughout the trip. We did an evening ride, and I highly recommend it! The sunset is beautiful!

quotes.author: Matthew Stranix
quotes.text: We started our honeymoon doing a tour with Chris and it was absolutely incredible! The sunset views were breathtaking, and for someone who has never been in a helicopter before, I felt safe and comfortable the entire time. Chris is extremely knowledgeable and fun! 10/10 would recommend!!

quotes.author: mrswortley
quotes.text: I went up with my two boys (6 and 9.) We had an amazing experience! The view was awesome and Chris did an awesome job explaining everything, making us feel safe and comfortable, and telling us about the sights. I would definitely recommend this to anyone wanting to make some amazing memories!

quotes.author: Kielan Dietrich
quotes.text: Chris was our pilot today. INCREDIBLE experience!! Smooth take-off, landing and everything in between. He was easy to talk to and had a very welcoming personality. Would recommend to anyone!!! We will definitely be coming back. Would post pictures of today but can’t figure out how lol

quotes.author: Aaron Mehner
quotes.text: Chris was fantastic and helped me and my team meet our goals – we needed some photo work done for a research project at ASU. He was fun, knowledgeable, accommodating, and trustworthy. 10/10 recommend SunState! This is a wonderful company and awesome experience!

quotes.author: Robert Moses
quotes.text: Took the wife and I on the paradise Valley 20 min tour. Worth the money. We wanted a sunset flight and were a bit early he stayed in the air a little extra time so we could catch it. We will definitly be going again!!! Thanks Chris for an awesome flight!

quotes.author: DC C
quotes.text: SunState Helicopter Tours is absolutely top notch. We flew in a beautiful helicopter with a very knowledgeable and experienced pilot! He was polite, professional, and a very competent gentleman who showed us some amazing sites. I’ve flown in dozens of helicopters, and this by far was the best flight I’ve ever had. I sought this company out because of their safety rating as a birthday present for my wife, who had an amazing time. I would recommend this company over any other in the Phoenix area. We will definitely take more tours from Chris in the future!
